final: WITH group_avgs AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebrate / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS group_avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg_ratio) AS avg_group_ratio FROM group_avgs) SELECT g.orderslink, g.group_avg_ratio, g.record_count, g.group_avg_ratio / o.avg_group_ratio AS normalized_ratio FROM group_avgs AS g CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o WHERE g.group_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND o.avg_group_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY normalized_ratio IS NULL, normalized_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
